# Pinned GenAI content schemas

Vendored from OpenTelemetry semantic-conventions v1.40.0, commit `7fe537301d17919af7d7eb65b32e9be35da2c497`, under `docs/gen-ai/`: `gen-ai-input-messages.json`, `gen-ai-output-messages.json`, and `gen-ai-system-instructions.json`. The local filenames omit the `gen-ai-` prefix. Used only in Bun conformance tests.

Source: [semantic-conventions v1.40.0](https://github.com/open-telemetry/semantic-conventions/tree/7fe537301d17919af7d7eb65b32e9be35da2c497/docs/gen-ai).
